desc: Mid-sized and lightweight, the inconspicuous Gravel easily fits in virtually any pocket, backpack, or bag, awaiting the perfect opportunity to take on everyday tasks requiring its smooth slicing and piercing capabilities. When the time comes, it opens quickly, revealing a sleek, custom reverse tanto blade with an aggressive, modern appearance. For the knife user looking for a subtle, dependable EDC, the Gravel is a great choice. Made with pride by Kershaw Knives – you can trust the quality and experience with any Kershaw product.
